related_questions.question: How do you pay property taxes in NY?
related_questions.snippet: You can pay your property taxes with your checking or savings account through Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT). EFT transfers funds from your bank account to the Department of Finance's bank account. There's no service fee from DOF. Contact your bank to determine if they charge a service fee.

related_questions.question: How do I see how much taxes are on a property?
related_questions.title: The step-by-step process
list: The county tax assessor determines the value of each property in the area.
The local government sets the county tax rate (also known as the mill rate).
The mill rate is multiplied by your property's assessed value to calculate your property taxes.
